Class ResumeGameEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.serverevents.ServerEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.net.events.serverevents.ResumeGameEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ResumeGameEvent extends ServerEvent
Represents an event sent from the server to resume the state of the game for a client
